# ZAC Forge

> ZAC is a group of senior IT professionals who bring clarity and sanity to
> AI. We use AI where it helps, and human experience and judgment where it
> doesn't. Start with a free senior review of your project.

ZAC is built on the practice Andrew Johnston has run since 2010, with decades
of Fortune 50 experience, including IBM.com and the IBM Design Lab. Works
remotely with clients anywhere in the US.

## About

- [About ZAC](https://zacforge.com/about): what ZAC is, and the three
  principals. Andrew Johnston, Founder, Principal. Misha Gervits, Design
  Principal. Luciano Monegatto (Luke), Principal Engineer.

## Start here

- [The Reality Check](https://zacforge.com/reality-check): a free senior
  review of your project for anything that's broken, AI or otherwise, against
  5 questions: does it work, is it fast, can everyone use it, can anyone find
  it, does it look like you. A prioritized report of what's broken and how to
  fix it.
- [The Fix](https://zacforge.com/fix-week): the Fix Week, one week, one agreed
  price. The top item on the Reality Check scorecard resolved in the client's code, a
  design review of the screen that looks most machine-made, and a ranked list of
  what is left. If it isn't fixed, it's free. New builds from the ground up are
  quoted as their own project.

## Services

- [AI Visibility](https://zacforge.com/ai-visibility): starts with the free
  Reality Check, which asks ChatGPT, Google, and Perplexity the questions
  customers ask and shows who gets named. Then the work, quoted from the
  check: crawler access, structured data, answer pages, and third-party
  mentions, in order of impact. Then the same questions tracked every month as
  part of a Web Partner plan.
- [Accessibility](https://zacforge.com/accessibility): manual
  testing and code fixes to WCAG 2.1 AA, the standard named by the ADA Title
  II and HHS Section 504 web rules, with deadlines in 2027 and 2028 for
  public agencies and HHS-funded health providers. Findings ranked by risk,
  a written record, and no overlays. ZAC does not certify legal compliance.
- [Web Partner](https://zacforge.com/web-partner): ongoing senior care
  covering updates, backups, monitoring, change requests, one improvement a
  month, and visibility tracking. Not a maintenance plan.
- [Platform Escape](https://zacforge.com/platform-escape): off WordPress or
  Wix, onto a lean setup you own: cheaper to run, faster, safer, easier to
  find in search. You can still make your own simple updates.

## Track record

- [Case studies](https://zacforge.com/case-studies): every system below was
  built by our team and handed to the people who own it.
- Calvary Chapel Conejo Valley: 1,703 sermons from 2001 to 2026 rescued from
  a hosted platform with no backup, and the site rebuilt on a stack the
  church owns. Launching soon.
- Heritage Global Partners: all web properties including hgpauction.com, with
  real-time auction creation from the sale floor. Live since 2010, with over
  $1 billion in assets sold through the platform.
- Legacy Studios (Teddy Bear Portraits): a custom back end on WordPress and
  open source, with tablet point of sale on one central database, across 41
  states. The same platform runs separately branded portals for the US Naval
  Academy and the US Military Academy. Built 2016 to 2019, still running, now
  maintained by another team.
- [Disaster Legal Services California](https://disasterlegalservicesca.org/):
  California's disaster legal services portal, for Legal Access Alameda and the
  Disaster Legal Assistance Collaborative. It carried survivors of the 2025 Los
  Angeles fires to free legal help, in 7 languages.
